Goes here. How to find out who buys, in what situation, to make what progress, and what proof they need first. Specifically capturing manual research methods (mining Reddit and Amazon reviews) to uncover the functional, emotional, and social dimensions of a customer's struggle, including their deepest fears, current situations, failed past solutions, and verbatim vocabulary.
Not here. • Translating customer language and objections into ad hooks or video scripts -> 10-MCR • Designing pre-landers or congruent product pages for specific avatars -> 07-LPG

why: A protocol for manual qualitative research via Reddit and Amazon reviews, specifically focused on extracting raw emotional mind states, failed workarounds, and verbatim vocabulary rather than relying on LLM-generated personas.
topics: [research method, review mining, objection discovery, avatar record structure]

research method / manual research protocol prioritizing Reddit and public discussion forums (80%) and Amazon reviews (20%) over AI-generated outputs. review mining / extracting broken trust markers, failed past solutions, and exact vocabulary from product reviews. objection discovery / identifying previous failed solutions (e.g., Minoxidil, NeoGraft transplants) and understanding the emotional toll of the problem. avatar record structure / cataloging exact vernacular differences, specific situational context (e.g., 55-year-old empty nester with their third cat), and specific procedural vocabulary.

The specific manual research protocol: 60 minutes total, split into 30 minutes on public discussion forums (Reddit) and 30 minutes on Amazon reviews, acting as the avatar and searching exact problem statements (e.g., "my cat won't drink water Reddit"). Copy-pasting verbatim text into a central document and bolding specific emotional language, failed solutions, and situational context. The distinction between a broad demographic (e.g., women 45+) and a specific avatar with deep emotional context (e.g., an empty nester terrified of losing her last companion to a specific disease).

Skip. General advice against using AI. Persona templates with demographic fields and no job (e.g., generic profiles like "30+ year old woman with knee pain"). Creative ad execution details, such as hook writing, visual scripting, or landing page design, which belong downstream in application modules. General motivational content or complaints about lazy marketers.
Scope mix. The method is universal, so there is a real baseline here: every avatar must have quoted evidence, a trigger moment, and a job statement.
